title: Weather & quakes
lead: Sacramento can get winter storms, flooding near rivers, and occasional earthquakes. Live alerts sit above — what to do is below.

actions.title: Storm / high wind
do: Stay inside away from windows if winds are severe
Unplug outdoor gear and move patio furniture if you can do it safely
Watch for outages — Powerwall may keep lights on; Starlink is the backup internet
If a tree or line is down, stay clear and call 911 if it is on a road or touching a house

actions.title: Flood warning
do: Never drive through flooded streets — turn around
Move cars and valuables to higher ground if you have time
If officials say evacuate, leave early and follow their routes
Do not walk through moving water; six inches can knock you down

actions.title: Earthquake
do: Drop, Cover, and Hold On under a sturdy table or against an interior wall
Stay inside until shaking stops — then check for gas smells, sparks, or water leaks
If outside, move away from buildings, wires, and trees
Expect aftershocks; only call 911 for life-threatening emergencies
Text family instead of calling when you can — keep phone lines clear
